# POV Beauty secures $15 million in Series A funding

POV Beauty 

The range includes Drench It, Glaze It, Whip It, Drip It, and Chill It.  (Source: Supplied)

 

By Kaycee Enerva

POV Beauty has raised $15 million in a Series A funding round led by Silas Capital, with participation from Redo Capital and existing investor Imaginary Ventures. [...] The funding comes less than a year after the beauty brand, co-founded by influencer Mikayla Nogueira and industry veteran Ani Hadjinian, launched with a skin prep-focused product range.

Nogueira said the investment will support the brand’s next phase of growth, including expanding its product portfolio.

“Our community drives POV, and this investment is about honoring that community by dreaming even bigger,” she said. [...] “We have proven our scale potential through retailers like Sephora, who deeply believed in our vision, and our team delivered the operational excellence to successfully execute massive launches,” she said.

The company will also use the funding to expand its presence at Sephora, grow its team, strengthen its TikTok Shop business, and develop new skincare-makeup hybrid products.

“We knew early on that POV Beauty was something special,” added Kelly Dill of Imaginary Ventures.

title: POV Beauty Secures Series A Funding Led by Silas Capital to Expand Skin Prep Product Line | citybiz
content:
He added that the company’s Sephora launch and consumer response supported Silas Capital’s assessment of its growth potential.

RÉDO Capital, a New York-based growth equity firm focused on beauty, personal care, wellness and lifestyle businesses, also participated in the financing.

The firm’s investment portfolio includes Touchland, Dieux Skin, Prose, Vacation, Ellis Brooklyn and Thursday Boots. [...] The investment will support the company’s retail expansion, product development, team growth and e-commerce operations as it seeks to strengthen its position in the skin preparation category.

Financial terms of the funding round, including the amount raised and the company’s valuation, were not disclosed.

Founded in 2025, POV Beauty develops skincare and makeup preparation products designed to improve how cosmetics apply and perform. [...] “They’ve turned real community insight into a distinctive, high-performing product line, and they move from idea to execution with real precision,” Dill said.

The new investment comes as POV Beauty works to expand beyond its initial product launches and build a larger retail and digital commerce business.

Its growth strategy combines traditional beauty retail distribution with social commerce platforms and direct consumer engagement.
